resources.string: Combine favorites, ratings and tags to find what you want to watch.
Search and statuses stay close to the list. Extra filters share one panel, cards have aligned actions and more room for titles, and the sign-in page scrolls comfortably with larger text.
Overlays use a dimmed, sharp background. The header back button follows the closing animation, and switching pages no longer zooms the content.
Clearer notifications and a new icon
Notifications separate the title, episode and time. System alerts use a crisp small icon and readable expanded text. The launcher and themed icon share a new calendar and play symbol.
